infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Trivora uses your location to show your real position on the map and route you to pickups and drop-offs.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Trivora needs Always location access to keep sending your GPS position for coding-violation monitoring while your shift is active, even if the app is in the background or the screen is locked.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Trivora uses your location to show your real position on the map and route you to pickups and drop-offs.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Trivora needs Always location access to keep sending your GPS position for coding-violation monitoring while your shift is active, even if the app is in the background or the screen is locked.

plugins.photosPermission: Trivora needs access to your photos so you can set a profile picture or attach evidence to a violation appeal.
plugins.cameraPermission: Trivora needs camera access so you can take a profile picture or a photo as evidence for a violation appeal.
